title.zh: 卷五十四 志第六: 曆三
title.raw: 卷五十四 志第六: 曆三 Volume 54 Treatises 7: Calendar 3

sentences.zh: ○授時曆經上△步氣朔第一

translations.literal: ○ Season-Granting Calendar Classic, Upper Part △ Procedure for Qi and New Moons, First
translations.idiomatic: ○ The Season-Granting Calendar Classic, Upper Part △ First Procedure: Qi and New Moons

sentences.zh: 至元十八年歲次辛巳為元。

translations.literal: The eighteenth year of Zhiyuan, when the year is xinsi, is taken as the epoch.
translations.idiomatic: The calendar epoch is the eighteenth year of the Zhiyuan reign (1281 CE), the cyclical year xinsi.

sentences.zh: 〈（上考往古，下驗將來，皆距立元為算。

translations.literal: (Whether examining antiquity upward or verifying the future downward, all reckonings take the distance to the established epoch as the basis.
translations.idiomatic: (Whether one looks back into antiquity or tests the future, every calculation measures distance from the established epoch.

sentences.zh: 周歲消長，百年各一，其諸應等數，隨時推測，不用為元。）〉

translations.literal: (The circuit year lengthens and shortens, one [unit] per century each; the various corresponding numbers are deduced according to the time and are not used as the epoch.)
translations.idiomatic: (The tropical year lengthens or shortens by one unit per century; other corresponding constants are computed for the period in question and are not built into the epoch.)

sentences.zh: 日周，一萬。

translations.literal: Day circuit: ten thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Day divisor: 10,000.

sentences.zh: 歲實，三百六十五萬二千四百二十五分。

translations.literal: Tropical year [length]: 3,652,425 parts.
translations.idiomatic: Tropical year value: 3,652,425 parts.

sentences.zh: 通余，五萬二千四百二十五分。

translations.literal: Common remainder: 52,425 parts.
translations.idiomatic: Common remainder: 52,425 parts.

sentences.zh: 朔實，二十九萬五千三百五分九十三秒。

translations.literal: New-moon [month] length: 295,305 parts 93 seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Synodic month length: 295,305 parts and 93 seconds.

sentences.zh: 通閏，十萬八千七百五十三分八十四秒。

translations.literal: Common intercalation: 108,753 parts 84 seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Common intercalation remainder: 108,753 parts and 84 seconds.

sentences.zh: 歲周，三百六十五日二千四百二十五分。

translations.literal: Year circuit: 365 days 2,425 parts.
translations.idiomatic: Year circuit: 365 days and 2,425 parts.

sentences.zh: 朔策，二十九日五千三百五分九十三秒。

translations.literal: New-moon interval: 29 days 5,305 parts 93 seconds.
translations.idiomatic: New-moon interval: 29 days, 5,305 parts, and 93 seconds.

sentences.zh: 氣策，十五日二千一百八十四分三十七秒半。

translations.literal: Qi interval: 15 days 2,184 parts 37 and a half seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Qi interval: 15 days, 2,184 parts, and 37½ seconds.

sentences.zh: 望策，十四日七千六百五十二分九十六秒半。

translations.literal: Full-moon interval: 14 days 7,652 parts 96 and a half seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Full-moon interval: 14 days, 7,652 parts, and 96½ seconds.

sentences.zh: 弦策，七日三千八百二十六分四十八秒少。

translations.literal: Quarter-moon interval: 7 days 3,826 parts 48 seconds slightly less.
translations.idiomatic: Quarter-moon interval: 7 days, 3,826 parts, and slightly less than 48 seconds.

sentences.zh: 氣應，五十五萬六百分。

translations.literal: Qi correspondence: 556,000 parts.
translations.idiomatic: Qi epoch offset: 556,000 parts.

sentences.zh: 閏應，二十萬一千八百五十分。

translations.literal: Intercalation correspondence: 201,850 parts.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalation epoch offset: 201,850 parts.

sentences.zh: 沒限，七千八百一十五分六十二秒半。

translations.literal: Extinction limit: 7,815 parts 62 and a half seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Extinction limit: 7,815 parts and 62½ seconds.

sentences.zh: 氣盈，二千一百八十四分三十七秒半。

translations.literal: Qi excess: 2,184 parts 37 and a half seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Qi excess: 2,184 parts and 37½ seconds.

sentences.zh: 朔虛，四千六百九十四分七秒。

translations.literal: New-moon deficit: 4,694 parts 7 seconds.
translations.idiomatic: New-moon deficit: 4,694 parts and 7 seconds.

sentences.zh: 旬周，六十萬。

translations.literal: Ten-day circuit: six hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Sexagenary cycle divisor: 600,000.

sentences.zh: 紀法，六十。

translations.literal: Era method: sixty.
translations.idiomatic: Sexagenary cycle length: 60.

sentences.zh: 推天正冬至

translations.literal: Procedure for the winter solstice of the celestial first month
translations.idiomatic: To compute the winter solstice of the celestial first month

sentences.zh: 置所求距算，以歲實

translations.literal: Set the sought distance count; multiply by the tropical year [length]
translations.idiomatic: Take the distance count for the date sought and multiply it by the tropical year value

sentences.zh: 〈（上推往古，每百年長一；

translations.literal: (When projecting antiquity upward, for each century add one;
translations.idiomatic: (When projecting into the past, add one per century;

sentences.zh: 下算將來，每百年消一。）〉

translations.literal: (when calculating the future downward, for each century subtract one.)
translations.idiomatic: (when calculating the future, subtract one per century.)

sentences.zh: 乘之，為中積。

translations.literal: Multiply it; this is the mean accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: The product is the mean accumulation.

sentences.zh: 加氣應，為通積。

translations.literal: Add the qi correspondence; this is the general accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: Add the qi epoch offset to obtain the general accumulation.

sentences.zh: 滿旬周，去之；

translations.literal: When it fills the ten-day circuit, remove it;
translations.idiomatic: Remove multiples of the sexagenary cycle divisor;

sentences.zh: 不盡，以日周約之為日，不滿為分。

translations.literal: what remains, reduce by the day circuit to obtain days; what does not fill [a day] is parts.
translations.idiomatic: divide the remainder by the day divisor to get days; the remainder is fractional parts.

sentences.zh: 其日命甲子算外，即所求天正冬至日辰及分。

translations.literal: Name the day counting from jiazi outside the count; that is the sought winter solstice of the celestial first month, day, double-hour, and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Count the day from jiazi outside the reckoning; this gives the winter solstice of the celestial first month—the day, double-hour, and fractional parts sought.

sentences.zh: 〈（如上考者，以氣應減中積，滿旬周，去之；

translations.literal: (As in the upward examination, subtract the qi correspondence from the mean accumulation; when it fills the ten-day circuit, remove it;
translations.idiomatic: (For backward projection, subtract the qi epoch offset from the mean accumulation, then remove multiples of the sexagenary cycle divisor;

sentences.zh: 不盡，以減旬周。

translations.literal: what remains, subtract from the ten-day circuit.
translations.idiomatic: subtract the remainder from the sexagenary cycle divisor.

sentences.zh: 餘同上。）〉

translations.literal: (The remainder is as above.)
translations.idiomatic: (Proceed with the remainder as above.)

sentences.zh: 求次氣

translations.literal: To seek the next qi
translations.idiomatic: To compute the next qi

sentences.zh: 置天正冬至日分，以氣策累加之，其日滿紀法，去之，外命如前，各得次氣日辰及分秒。

translations.literal: Set the winter solstice day and parts of the celestial first month; add the qi interval cumulatively; when the day fills the era method, remove it; name from outside as before—each yields the next qi day, double-hour, and parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Take the winter solstice day and fractional parts; add the qi interval repeatedly; when days reach 60, discard the cycle; count from outside as before to obtain each successive qi—its day, double-hour, and parts and seconds.

sentences.zh: 推天正經朔

translations.literal: Procedure for the standard new moon of the celestial first month
translations.idiomatic: To compute the standard new moon of the celestial first month

sentences.zh: 置中積，加閏應，為閏積。

translations.literal: Set the mean accumulation; add the intercalation correspondence; this is the intercalation accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: Take the mean accumulation, add the intercalation epoch offset, and call the result the intercalation accumulation.

sentences.zh: 滿朔實，去之不盡，為閏余，以減通積，為朔積。

translations.literal: When it fills the new-moon length, remove it; what does not exhaust is the intercalation remainder; subtract from the general accumulation; this is the new-moon accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: Divide by the synodic month length and keep the remainder as the intercalation remainder; subtract this from the general accumulation to obtain the new-moon accumulation.

sentences.zh: 滿旬周，去之；

translations.literal: When it fills the ten-day circuit, remove it;
translations.idiomatic: Remove multiples of the sexagenary cycle divisor;

sentences.zh: 不盡，以日周約之，為日，不滿為分，即所求天正經朔日及分秒。

translations.literal: what remains, reduce by the day circuit to days; what does not fill is parts—this is the sought standard new moon of the celestial first month, day and parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: divide the remainder by the day divisor for days and keep the leftover as parts—this yields the standard new moon of the celestial first month: its day and fractional parts and seconds.

sentences.zh: 〈（上考者，以閏應減中積，滿朔實，去之不盡，以減朔實，為閏余。

translations.literal: (For the upward examination, subtract the intercalation correspondence from the mean accumulation; when it fills the new-moon length, remove it; what does not exhaust, subtract from the new-moon length—this is the intercalation remainder.
translations.idiomatic: (For backward projection, subtract the intercalation epoch offset from the mean accumulation; divide by the synodic month length and keep the remainder; subtract this from the synodic month length to obtain the intercalation remainder.

sentences.zh: 以日周約之為日，不滿為分，以減冬至日及分，不及減者，加紀法減之，命如上。）〉

translations.literal: (Reduce by the day circuit to days; what does not fill is parts; subtract from the winter solstice day and parts; if insufficient to subtract, add the era method and subtract; name as above.)
translations.idiomatic: (Convert to days via the day divisor, with the remainder as parts; subtract from the winter solstice day and parts; if the subtraction underflows, add 60 and subtract again; count as above.)

sentences.zh: 求弦望及次朔

translations.literal: To seek the quarter-moons, full moons, and successive new moons
translations.idiomatic: To compute quarter-moons, full moons, and successive new moons

sentences.zh: 置天正經朔日及分秒，以弦策累加之，其日滿紀法，去之，各得弦望及次朔日及分秒。

translations.literal: Set the standard new moon day and parts and seconds of the celestial first month; add the quarter-moon interval cumulatively; when the day fills the era method, remove it—each yields the quarter-moon, full moon, and successive new moon days and parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Take the standard new moon day with its parts and seconds; add the quarter-moon interval repeatedly, discarding cycles of 60 days; each step yields a quarter-moon, full moon, or successive new moon with its day and parts and seconds.

sentences.zh: 推沒日

translations.literal: Procedure for extinction days
translations.idiomatic: To compute extinction days

sentences.zh: 置有沒之氣分秒，

translations.literal: Set the qi parts and seconds that have extinction,
translations.idiomatic: Take the qi whose fractional parts and seconds qualify for extinction,

sentences.zh: 〈（如沒限已上為有沒之氣。）〉

translations.literal: (If at or above the extinction limit, it is a qi that has extinction.)
translations.idiomatic: (A qi whose remainder is at or above the extinction limit qualifies.)

sentences.zh: 以十五乘之，用減氣策，余滿氣盈而一，為日，並恒氣日，命為沒日。

translations.literal: Multiply by fifteen; use it to subtract from the qi interval; the remainder, when it fills the qi excess, count one as a day; combine with the constant qi day; name it the extinction day.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by 15, subtract from the qi interval, divide the remainder by the qi excess to get days, add these to the fixed qi day, and name the result the extinction day.

sentences.zh: 推滅日

translations.literal: Procedure for annihilation days
translations.idiomatic: To compute annihilation days

sentences.zh: 置有滅之朔分秒，

translations.literal: Set the new-moon parts and seconds that have annihilation,
translations.idiomatic: Take the new moon whose fractional parts and seconds qualify for annihilation,

sentences.zh: 〈（在朔虛分已下為有滅之朔。）〉

translations.literal: (If at or below the new-moon deficit parts, it is a new moon that has annihilation.)
translations.idiomatic: (A new moon whose remainder is at or below the new-moon deficit qualifies.)

sentences.zh: 以三十乘之，滿朔虛而一，為日，並經朔日，命為滅日。

translations.literal: Multiply by thirty; when it fills the new-moon deficit, count one as a day; combine with the standard new-moon day; name it the annihilation day.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by 30, divide by the new-moon deficit to get days, add these to the standard new-moon day, and name the result the annihilation day.

sentences.zh: △步發斂第二土王策，三日四百三十六分八十七秒半。

translations.literal: △ Procedure for Ebb and Flow, Second. Earth-king interval: 3 days 436 parts 87 and a half seconds.
translations.idiomatic: △ Second Procedure: Ebb and Flow. Earth-sovereign interval: 3 days, 436 parts, and 87½ seconds.

sentences.zh: 月閏，九千六十二分八十二秒。

translations.literal: Monthly intercalation: 9,062 parts 82 seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Monthly intercalation offset: 9,062 parts and 82 seconds.

sentences.zh: 辰法，一萬。

translations.literal: Double-hour method: ten thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Double-hour divisor: 10,000.

sentences.zh: 半辰法，五千。

translations.literal: Half double-hour method: five thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Half double-hour divisor: 5,000.

sentences.zh: 刻法，一千二百。

translations.literal: Quarter method: one thousand two hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Quarter (ke) divisor: 1,200.

sentences.zh: 推五行用事

translations.literal: Procedure for the dominion of the Five Phases
translations.idiomatic: To compute when each of the Five Phases holds dominion

sentences.zh: 各以四立之節，為春木、夏火、秋金、冬水首用事日。

translations.literal: For each, take the four establishment nodes as the first dominion days of spring wood, summer fire, autumn metal, and winter water.
translations.idiomatic: The four seasonal establishment nodes mark the first dominion days of spring (wood), summer (fire), autumn (metal), and winter (water) respectively.

sentences.zh: 以土王策減四季中氣，各得其季土始用事日。

translations.literal: Subtract the earth-king interval from each season's mid-qi; each yields the season's earth first dominion day.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the earth-sovereign interval from each season's mid-qi to obtain when earth first holds dominion in that season.

sentences.zh: 氣候正月

translations.literal: Climatic phenomena: first month
translations.idiomatic: Climatic pentads: the first month

sentences.zh: 立春，正月節東風解凍蟄蟲始振魚陟負冰

translations.literal: Beginning of Spring, first-month minor term: east wind melts the ice; hibernating creatures begin to stir; fish ascend; ice carries [them].
translations.idiomatic: Beginning of Spring, first-month minor term: the east wind melts the ice; hibernating insects begin to stir; fish rise; ice floats with them.

sentences.zh: 雨水，正月中獺祭魚候雁北草木萌動二月

translations.literal: Rain Water, first-month mid-term: otters sacrifice fish; wild geese [return] north; grass and trees put forth shoots. Second month.
translations.idiomatic: Rain Water, first-month mid-term: otters offer fish; migrating geese head north; grass and trees sprout. Second month.

sentences.zh: 驚蟄，二月節桃始華倉鹒鳴鷹化為鳩春分，二月中玄鳥至雷乃發聲始電三月

translations.literal: Awakening of Insects, second-month minor term: peaches begin to bloom; orioles sing; hawks change into cuckoos. Spring Equinox, second-month mid-term: dark birds arrive; thunder first sounds; lightning first appears. Third month.
translations.idiomatic: Awakening of Insects, second-month minor term: peach blossoms open; orioles call; hawks turn into turtledoves. Spring Equinox, second-month mid-term: swallows arrive; thunder first rolls; lightning first flashes. Third month.

sentences.zh: 清明，三月節桐始華田鼠化為釐虹始見

translations.literal: Clear and Bright, third-month minor term: paulownia begins to bloom; field mice change into quails; rainbows first appear.
translations.idiomatic: Clear and Bright, third-month minor term: paulownia flowers; field mice become quails; rainbows first appear.

sentences.zh: 谷雨，三月中萍始生鳴鳩拂其羽戴勝降於桑四月立夏，四月節螻蟈鳴蚯蚓出王瓜生小滿，四月中苦萊秀靡草死麥秋至

translations.literal: Grain Rain, third-month mid-term: duckweed begins to grow; calling doves preen their feathers; hoopoes descend upon mulberry. Fourth month. Beginning of Summer, fourth-month minor term: tree frogs cry; earthworms emerge; snake-gourds grow. Lesser Fullness, fourth-month mid-term: bitter greens flourish; rank grasses die; wheat reaches autumn [ripeness].
translations.idiomatic: Grain Rain, third-month mid-term: duckweed sprouts; turtledoves preen; hoopoes alight on mulberry trees. Fourth month. Beginning of Summer, fourth-month minor term: tree frogs sing; earthworms surface; snake-gourds sprout. Lesser Fullness, fourth-month mid-term: bitter herbs flourish; tender grasses wither; wheat ripens.

sentences.zh: 芒種，五月節螳螂生鵙始鳴反舌無聲夏至，五月中鹿角解蜩始鳴半夏生六月

translations.literal: Bearded Grain, fifth-month minor term: mantises are born; shrikes first cry; mockingbirds fall silent. Summer Solstice, fifth-month mid-term: deer antlers shed; cicadas first cry; pinellia grows. Sixth month.
translations.idiomatic: Bearded Grain, fifth-month minor term: mantises hatch; shrikes begin to call; mockingbirds go quiet. Summer Solstice, fifth-month mid-term: deer shed their antlers; cicadas first sing; pinellia flourishes. Sixth month.

sentences.zh: 小暑，六月節溫風至蟋蟀居壁鷹始摯

translations.literal: Lesser Heat, sixth-month minor term: warm winds arrive; crickets dwell in walls; hawks first strike [prey].
translations.idiomatic: Lesser Heat, sixth-month minor term: warm breezes blow; crickets move into walls; hawks begin to hunt.

sentences.zh: 大暑，六月中腐草為螢土潤溽暑大雨時行七月立秋，七月節涼風至白露降寒蟬鳴處暑，七月中鷹乃祭鳥天地始肅禾乃登

translations.literal: Greater Heat, sixth-month mid-term: rotten grass becomes fireflies; earth is moist; oppressive heat; great rains fall at times. Seventh month. Beginning of Autumn, seventh-month minor term: cool winds arrive; white dew descends; cold cicadas cry. End of Heat, seventh-month mid-term: hawks sacrifice birds; heaven and earth begin to grow austere; grain crops ripen.
translations.idiomatic: Greater Heat, sixth-month mid-term: rotting grass turns into fireflies; the soil is damp; sultry heat; heavy rains come and go. Seventh month. Beginning of Autumn, seventh-month minor term: cool winds blow; white dew falls; cold cicadas chirp. End of Heat, seventh-month mid-term: hawks offer birds; heaven and earth turn stern; grain comes to harvest.

sentences.zh: 白露，八月節鴻雁來玄鳥歸群鳥養羞秋分，八月中雷始收聲蟄蟲壞戶水始涸九月

translations.literal: White Dew, eighth-month minor term: wild geese arrive; dark birds return; flocking birds store provisions. Autumn Equinox, eighth-month mid-term: thunder first ceases; hibernating creatures damage their doors; water first dries up. Ninth month.
translations.idiomatic: White Dew, eighth-month minor term: wild geese arrive; swallows depart; flocking birds lay up food. Autumn Equinox, eighth-month mid-term: thunder falls silent; hibernating insects seal their burrows; waters begin to recede. Ninth month.

sentences.zh: 寒露，九月節鴻雁來賓雀入大水為蛤菊有黃華

translations.literal: Cold Dew, ninth-month minor term: wild geese arrive as guests; sparrows enter the great waters and become clams; chrysanthemums show yellow flowers.
translations.idiomatic: Cold Dew, ninth-month minor term: guest wild geese arrive; sparrows dive into the waters and turn into clams; chrysanthemums bloom yellow.

sentences.zh: 霜降，九月中豺乃祭獸草木黃落蟄蟲咸俯十月

translations.literal: Frost's Descent, ninth-month mid-term: jackals sacrifice beasts; grass and trees turn yellow and fall; hibernating creatures all bow down. Tenth month.
translations.idiomatic: Frost's Descent, ninth-month mid-term: jackals offer their prey; grass and trees yellow and shed; hibernating creatures all lie low. Tenth month.

sentences.zh: 立冬，十月節水始冰地始凍雉入大水為蜃

translations.literal: Beginning of Winter, tenth-month minor term: water first freezes; earth first hardens; pheasants enter the great waters and become large clams.
translations.idiomatic: Beginning of Winter, tenth-month minor term: waters begin to freeze; the ground hardens; pheasants dive into the waters and become clams.

sentences.zh: 小雪，十月中虹藏不見天氣上升，地氣下降閉塞而成冬十一月大雪，十一月節鹖鴠不鳴虎始交荔挺出冬至，十一月中蚯蚓結麋角解水泉動

translations.literal: Lesser Snow, tenth-month mid-term: rainbows hide and are not seen; heaven's qi rises; earth's qi descends; obstruction closes and winter forms. Eleventh month. Greater Snow, eleventh-month minor term: cold-weather birds do not cry; tigers first mate; winter wheat sprouts. Winter Solstice, eleventh-month mid-term: earthworms knot; elk antlers shed; spring waters stir.
translations.idiomatic: Lesser Snow, tenth-month mid-term: rainbows vanish; yang qi ascends; yin qi descends; the world seals into winter. Eleventh month. Greater Snow, eleventh-month minor term: cold-weather birds fall silent; tigers begin to mate; winter wheat sprouts. Winter Solstice, eleventh-month mid-term: earthworms coil; elk shed antlers; springs begin to flow.

sentences.zh: 十二月小寒，十二月節雁北鄉鵲始巢雉雊

translations.literal: Twelfth month. Lesser Cold, twelfth-month minor term: wild geese [go] north homeward; magpies first build nests; pheasants crow.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month. Lesser Cold, twelfth-month minor term: wild geese head for the north; magpies begin to nest; pheasants call.

sentences.zh: 大寒，十二月中雞乳征鳥厲疾水澤腹堅推中氣去經朔

translations.literal: Greater Cold, twelfth-month mid-term: hens brood; migratory birds are swift and fierce; water in marshes is firm at the belly. Procedure for mid-qi distance from the standard new moon
translations.idiomatic: Greater Cold, twelfth-month mid-term: hens hatch chicks; migratory birds fly hard; ice thickens at the center of marshes. To compute mid-qi offset from the standard new moon

sentences.zh: 置天正閏余，以日周約之，為日，命之，得冬至去經朔。

translations.literal: Set the intercalation remainder of the celestial first month; reduce by the day circuit to days; name it—this yields the winter solstice's distance from the standard new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Take the celestial first month's intercalation remainder, convert it to days via the day divisor, and count them to obtain the winter solstice's offset from the standard new moon.

sentences.zh: 以月閏累加之，各得中氣去經朔日算。

translations.literal: Add the monthly intercalation cumulatively; each yields the mid-qi distance from the standard new moon in day counts.
translations.idiomatic: Add the monthly intercalation offset repeatedly to obtain each mid-qi's day-count distance from the standard new moon.

sentences.zh: 〈（滿朔策，去之，乃全置閏，然俟定朔無中氣者裁之。）〉

translations.literal: (When it fills the new-moon interval, remove it; only then fully set intercalation—but wait until the determined new moon lacks a mid-qi, then trim it.)
translations.idiomatic: (Discard full synodic-month cycles; only then insert an intercalary month—but trim any month whose true new moon contains no mid-qi.)

sentences.zh: 推發斂加時

translations.literal: Procedure for ebb-and-flow with added double-hours
translations.idiomatic: To compute ebb-and-flow with added double-hours

sentences.zh: 置所求分秒，以十二乘之，滿辰法而一，為辰數；

translations.literal: Set the sought parts and seconds; multiply by twelve; when it fills the double-hour method, count one—this is the double-hour count;
translations.idiomatic: Take the parts and seconds sought, multiply by 12, and divide by the double-hour divisor to obtain the double-hour count;

sentences.zh: 余以刻法收之，為刻；

translations.literal: the remainder, collect by the quarter method—this is quarters;
translations.idiomatic: collect the remainder with the quarter divisor to obtain quarters;

sentences.zh: 命子正算外，即所在辰刻。

translations.literal: name from zi upright outside the count—this is the double-hour and quarter where it stands.
translations.idiomatic: count from midnight (zi) outside the reckoning to locate the double-hour and quarter.

sentences.zh: 〈（如滿半辰法，通作一辰，命起子初。）〉

translations.literal: (If it fills the half double-hour method, carry as one double-hour; name from the beginning of zi.)
translations.idiomatic: (If the remainder reaches half a double-hour divisor, carry one full double-hour and count from the start of zi.)

sentences.zh: 推天正經朔弦望入盈縮歷

translations.literal: Procedure for the standard new moon, quarter-moons, and full moons of the celestial first month entering the expansion-contraction sequence
translations.idiomatic: To compute when the celestial first month's standard new moon, quarter-moons, and full moons enter the expansion-contraction sequence

sentences.zh: 置半歲周，以閏余日及分減之，即得天正經朔入縮歷。

translations.literal: Set the half-year circuit; subtract the intercalation remainder days and parts—this yields the standard new moon of the celestial first month entering the contraction sequence.
translations.idiomatic: Take the half-year circuit and subtract the intercalation remainder in days and parts to obtain the celestial first month's standard new moon entering the contraction sequence.

sentences.zh: 〈（冬至後盈，夏至後縮。）〉

translations.literal: (After the winter solstice, expansion; after the summer solstice, contraction.)
translations.idiomatic: (After the winter solstice the sun slows; after the summer solstice it speeds up.)

sentences.zh: 以弦策累加之，各得弦望及次朔入盈縮歷日及分秒。

translations.literal: Add the quarter-moon interval cumulatively; each yields the quarter-moon, full moon, and successive new moon entering the expansion-contraction sequence—days and parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Add the quarter-moon interval repeatedly to obtain each quarter-moon, full moon, and successive new moon entering the expansion-contraction sequence, with its days, parts, and seconds.

sentences.zh: 〈（滿半歲周去之，即交盈縮。）〉

translations.literal: (When it fills the half-year circuit, remove it—this is crossing expansion and contraction.)
translations.idiomatic: (Discard full half-year circuits; this marks the transition between expansion and contraction.)

sentences.zh: 求盈縮差

translations.literal: To seek the expansion-contraction difference
translations.idiomatic: To compute the expansion-contraction correction

sentences.zh: 視入歷盈者，在盈初縮末限已下，為初限，已上，反減半歲周，余為末限；

translations.literal: If entering the sequence as expansion, when below the expansion-initial contraction-final limit, it is the initial limit; when at or above, inversely subtract the half-year circuit—the remainder is the final limit;
translations.idiomatic: If the entry is in the expansion phase: below the expansion-initial limit counts as the initial segment; at or above, subtract from the half-year circuit to get the final segment;

sentences.zh: 縮者，在縮初盈末限已下，為初限，已上，反減半歲周，余為末限。

translations.literal: If contraction, when below the contraction-initial expansion-final limit, it is the initial limit; when at or above, inversely subtract the half-year circuit—the remainder is the final limit.
translations.idiomatic: If the entry is in the contraction phase: below the contraction-initial limit counts as the initial segment; at or above, subtract from the half-year circuit to get the final segment.

sentences.zh: 其盈初縮末者，置立差三十一，以初末限乘之，加平差二萬四千六百，又以初末限乘之，用減定差五百一十三萬三千二百，余再以初末限乘之，滿億為度，不滿退除為分秒。

translations.literal: For expansion-initial contraction-final: set the fixed difference at 31; multiply by the initial-final limit; add the mean difference 24,600; multiply again by the initial-final limit; subtract from the fixed difference 5,133,200; multiply the remainder again by the initial-final limit; when it fills 100 million, count as degrees; what does not fill, step back and reduce to parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: For the expansion-initial / contraction-final case: set the base difference to 31, multiply by the segment limit, add the mean difference 24,600, multiply again, subtract from the fixed difference 5,133,200, multiply the remainder once more, divide by 100 million for degrees, and reduce the remainder to parts and seconds.

sentences.zh: 縮初盈末者，置立差二十七，以初末限乘之，加平差二萬二千一百，又以初末限乘之，用減定差四百八十七萬六百，余再以初末限乘之，滿億為度，不滿退除為分秒，即所求盈縮差。

translations.literal: For contraction-initial expansion-final: set the fixed difference at 27; multiply by the initial-final limit; add the mean difference 22,100; multiply again; subtract from the fixed difference 4,870,600; multiply the remainder again; when it fills 100 million, count as degrees; what does not fill, step back to parts and seconds—this is the sought expansion-contraction difference.
translations.idiomatic: For the contraction-initial / expansion-final case: set the base difference to 27, multiply by the segment limit, add the mean difference 22,100, multiply again, subtract from the fixed difference 4,870,600, multiply the remainder once more, convert to degrees and parts and seconds—this is the expansion-contraction correction sought.

sentences.zh: 又術：置入限分，以其日盈縮分乘之，萬約為分，以加其下盈縮積，萬約為度，不滿為分秒，亦得所求盈縮差。

translations.literal: Alternate method: set the entry-limit parts; multiply by that day's expansion-contraction parts; reduce by ten thousand to parts; add to the expansion-contraction accumulation below; reduce by ten thousand to degrees; what does not fill is parts and seconds—this also yields the sought expansion-contraction difference.
translations.idiomatic: Alternate method: take the segment entry in parts, multiply by that day's expansion-contraction rate, scale by 10,000, add to the tabulated accumulation below, convert to degrees and parts and seconds—this also yields the correction sought.

translations.idiomatic: Take the mean accumulation, add the circuit epoch offset to form the general accumulation, and when it reaches the celestial circuit in parts,

sentences.zh: 〈（上推往古，每百年消一；

translations.literal: (When projecting antiquity upward, for each century subtract one;
translations.idiomatic: (When projecting into the past, subtract one per century;

sentences.zh: 下算將來，每百年長一。）〉

translations.idiomatic: (when calculating the future, add one per century.)

sentences.zh: 去之，不盡，以日周約之為度，不滿，退約為分秒。

translations.literal: remove it; what remains, reduce by the day circuit to degrees; what does not fill, step back and reduce to parts and seconds.

sentences.zh: 命起赤道虛宿六度外，去之，至不滿宿，即所求天正冬至加時日躔赤道宿度及分秒。

translations.literal: Name from Void lodge 6° on the equator outside the count; remove until less than one lodge—this is the sought winter solstice of the celestial first month at added double-hour, the sun's motion equatorial lodge degree and parts and seconds.

translations.literal: (For the upward examination, subtract the circuit correspondence from the mean accumulation; when it fills the circuit of heaven, remove it;
translations.idiomatic: (For backward projection, subtract the circuit epoch offset from the mean accumulation and remove full celestial circuits;

translations.literal: (The remainder is as above.)

sentences.zh: 如當時有宿度者，止依當時宿度命之。）〉

sentences.zh: 求四正赤道日度

translations.literal: To seek the four cardinal equatorial solar degrees
translations.idiomatic: To compute the four seasonal equatorial solar degrees

sentences.zh: 置天正冬至加時赤道日度，累加象限，滿赤道宿次，去之，各得春夏秋正日所在宿度及分秒。

translations.literal: Set the winter solstice equatorial solar degree at added double-hour of the celestial first month; add the quadrant limit cumulatively; when it fills the equatorial lodge sequence, remove it—each yields the lodge degree and parts and seconds where spring, summer, and autumn cardinal days stand.
translations.idiomatic: Take the celestial first month's winter solstice equatorial position and add the quadrant limit repeatedly, discarding full lodge cycles, to obtain the equatorial lodge positions for spring, summer, and autumn.

sentences.zh: 求四正赤道宿積度

translations.literal: To seek the four cardinal equatorial lodge accumulated degrees
translations.idiomatic: To compute accumulated equatorial degrees after each seasonal node

sentences.zh: 置四正赤道宿全度，以四正赤道日度及分減之，余為距後度；

translations.literal: Set the full degree of the four cardinal equatorial lodges; subtract the four cardinal equatorial solar degrees and parts—the remainder is the degree after the node;
translations.idiomatic: Take each seasonal lodge's full span and subtract the solar degree at that node; the remainder is the distance past the node;

sentences.zh: 以赤道宿度累加之，各得四正後赤道宿積度及分。

translations.literal: Add equatorial lodge degrees cumulatively; each yields the accumulated equatorial lodge degrees and parts after the four cardinals.
translations.idiomatic: Add equatorial lodge spans cumulatively to obtain the accumulated equatorial degrees after each seasonal node.

translations.idiomatic: Take the accumulated equatorial degree after a seasonal node, subtract the node's equatorial accumulation, multiply the difference by the ecliptic rate, and divide by the equatorial rate;

translations.idiomatic: add the result to the ecliptic accumulation to obtain the ecliptic accumulated degree for all twenty-eight lodges;

translations.literal: Subtract the previous lodge's ecliptic accumulated degree—this is that lodge's ecliptic degree and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the previous lodge's ecliptic accumulation to obtain that lodge's ecliptic span in degrees and parts.

translations.literal: Right—the ecliptic lodge degrees, calculated according to the equator measured by the present calendar and the winter solstice precession position, to serve as the basis for stepwise reckoning.
translations.idiomatic: These ecliptic lodge degrees are derived from the equatorial positions measured for the present calendar, adjusted for precession at the winter solstice, and serve as the basis for all computations.

sentences.zh: 若上下考驗，據歲差每移一度，依術推變，各得當時宿度。

translations.literal: If examining upward or downward, according to precession for each degree shifted, follow the procedure to derive the change—each yields the lodge degrees of that time.
translations.idiomatic: When verifying past or future dates, shift one degree per precession step and apply the formulas to obtain the lodge degrees valid for that era.

sentences.zh: 推冬至加時黃道日度

translations.literal: Procedure for the winter solstice ecliptic solar degree at added double-hour
translations.idiomatic: To compute the winter solstice solar degree on the ecliptic at the epoch hour

sentences.zh: 置天正冬至加時赤道日度，以其赤道積度減之，余以黃道率乘之，如赤道率而一；

translations.literal: Set the winter solstice equatorial solar degree at added double-hour of the celestial first month; subtract its equatorial accumulated degree; multiply the remainder by the ecliptic rate and divide by the equatorial rate;
translations.idiomatic: Take the celestial first month's winter solstice equatorial position, subtract its equatorial accumulation, multiply by the ecliptic rate, and divide by the equatorial rate;

translations.literal: what is obtained, add to the ecliptic accumulated degree—this is the sought year's winter solstice of the celestial first month at added double-hour, ecliptic solar degree and parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: add the result to the ecliptic accumulation to obtain the winter solstice ecliptic position for the year sought, in degrees and seconds.

sentences.zh: 求四正加時黃道日度

translations.literal: To seek the four cardinal ecliptic solar degrees at added double-hour
translations.idiomatic: To compute the four seasonal ecliptic solar degrees at the epoch hour

sentences.zh: 置所求年冬至日躔黃赤道差，與次年黃赤道差相減，余四而一，所得，加象限，為四正定象度。

translations.literal: Set the sought year's winter solstice solar motion yellow-red equatorial difference and the next year's yellow-red equatorial difference; subtract; divide the remainder by four; what is obtained, add the quadrant limit—this is the four cardinals' fixed quadrant degree.
translations.idiomatic: Take the ecliptic–equator correction at the winter solstice for the year sought and the following year, subtract, divide by four, add the quadrant limit, and obtain the fixed quadrant offset for the four seasonal nodes.

sentences.zh: 置冬至加時黃道日度，以四正定象度累加之，滿黃道宿次，去之，各得四正定氣加時黃道度及分。

translations.literal: Set the winter solstice ecliptic solar degree at added double-hour; add the four cardinals' fixed quadrant degree cumulatively; when it fills the ecliptic lodge sequence, remove it—each yields the four cardinals' fixed qi ecliptic degree and parts at added double-hour.
translations.idiomatic: Take the winter solstice ecliptic position and add the fixed quadrant offset repeatedly, discarding full lodge cycles, to obtain each seasonal node's ecliptic position in degrees and parts.

sentences.zh: 求四正晨前夜半日度

translations.literal: To seek the four cardinals' solar degrees at dawn before midnight
translations.idiomatic: To compute the four seasonal solar degrees at dawn before midnight

sentences.zh: 置四正恒氣日及分秒，

translations.literal: Set the four cardinals' constant qi days and parts and seconds,
translations.idiomatic: Take the four seasonal nodes' mean qi days and parts and seconds,

sentences.zh: 〈（冬夏二至，盈縮之端，以恒為定。）〉

translations.literal: (Winter and summer solstices are the extremes of expansion and contraction; use the constant as the fixed [value].)
translations.idiomatic: (At the two solstices—the turning points of expansion and contraction—use the mean value as the fixed correction.)

sentences.zh: 以盈縮差命為日分，盈減縮加之，即為四正定氣日及分。

translations.literal: Name the expansion-contraction difference as day-parts; expansion subtract, contraction add—this is the four cardinals' fixed qi days and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the expansion-contraction correction as fractional days—subtract for expansion, add for contraction—to obtain the true dates of the four seasonal nodes.

sentences.zh: 置日下分，以其日行度乘之，如日周而一；

translations.literal: Set the parts below the day; multiply by its daily motion degree; divide by the day circuit;
translations.idiomatic: Take the fractional parts of the day, multiply by the sun's daily motion, and divide by the day divisor;

sentences.zh: 所得，以減四正加時黃道日度，各得四正定氣晨前夜半日度及分秒。

translations.literal: what is obtained, subtract from the four cardinals' ecliptic solar degrees at added double-hour—each yields the four cardinals' fixed qi solar degrees at dawn before midnight and parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: subtract the result from each seasonal node's ecliptic position at the epoch hour to obtain the solar degree at dawn before midnight for that node.

sentences.zh: 求四正後每日晨前夜半黃道日度

translations.literal: To seek each day's ecliptic solar degree at dawn before midnight after the four cardinals
translations.idiomatic: To compute the daily ecliptic solar degree at dawn before midnight after each seasonal node

sentences.zh: 以四正定氣日距後正定氣日為相距日，以四正定氣晨前夜半日度距後正定氣晨前夜半日度為相距度，累計相距日之行定度，與相距度相減；

translations.literal: Take the four cardinals' fixed qi day to the next fixed qi day as the separation in days; take the four cardinals' fixed qi solar degree at dawn before midnight to the next as the separation in degrees; accumulate the fixed daily motion over the separation days and subtract from the separation in degrees;
translations.idiomatic: Let the interval in days run from one seasonal node's true date to the next, and the interval in degrees from one dawn-before-midnight position to the next; accumulate the sun's fixed daily motion over those days and subtract from the degree interval;

sentences.zh: 余如相距日而一，為日差；

translations.literal: the remainder, divide by the separation in days—this is the daily difference;
translations.idiomatic: divide the remainder by the day interval to obtain the daily correction;

sentences.zh: 〈（相距度多為加，相距度少為減。）〉

translations.literal: (If the separation in degrees is greater, add; if less, subtract.)
translations.idiomatic: (Add the daily correction when the degree interval is larger; subtract when it is smaller.)

sentences.zh: 以加減四正每日行度率，為每日行定度；

translations.literal: add or subtract to the four cardinals' daily motion rate—this is the fixed daily motion;
translations.idiomatic: adjust the mean daily motion rate by this correction to obtain the true daily motion;

sentences.zh: 累加四正晨前夜半黃道日度，滿宿次，去之，為每日晨前夜半黃道日度及分秒。

translations.literal: Add cumulatively from the four cardinals' ecliptic solar degree at dawn before midnight; when it fills the lodge sequence, remove it—this is each day's ecliptic solar degree at dawn before midnight and parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Accumulate from each seasonal node's dawn-before-midnight position, discarding full lodge cycles, to obtain the ecliptic solar degree at dawn before midnight for every day.

sentences.zh: 求每日午中黃道日度

translations.literal: To seek each day's ecliptic solar degree at noon
translations.idiomatic: To compute the daily ecliptic solar degree at noon

sentences.zh: 置其日行定度，半之，以加其日晨前夜半黃道日度，得午中黃道日度及分秒。

translations.literal: Set its fixed daily motion; halve it; add to that day's ecliptic solar degree at dawn before midnight—this yields the ecliptic solar degree at noon and parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Halve the true daily motion and add it to that day's dawn-before-midnight ecliptic position to obtain the noon ecliptic position.

sentences.zh: 求每日午中黃道積度

translations.literal: To seek each day's accumulated ecliptic degree at noon
translations.idiomatic: To compute the accumulated ecliptic degree at noon for each day

sentences.zh: 以二至加時黃道日度距所求日午中黃道日度，為二至後黃道積度及分秒。

translations.literal: Take the solstice ecliptic solar degree at added double-hour to the sought day's ecliptic solar degree at noon as the accumulated ecliptic degree and parts and seconds after the solstice.
translations.idiomatic: Measure from the solstice ecliptic position at the epoch hour to the sought day's noon position to obtain the accumulated ecliptic degrees since the solstice.

sentences.zh: 求每日午中赤道日度

translations.literal: To seek each day's equatorial solar degree at noon
translations.idiomatic: To compute the daily equatorial solar degree at noon

sentences.zh: 置所求日午中黃道積度，滿象限，去之，余為分後；

translations.literal: Set the sought day's accumulated ecliptic degree at noon; when it fills the quadrant limit, remove it—the remainder is after the division;
translations.idiomatic: Take the noon ecliptic accumulation for the day sought, discard full quadrant limits, and keep the remainder within the quadrant;

sentences.zh: 內減黃道積度，以赤道率乘之，如黃道率而一；

translations.literal: subtract inward from the ecliptic accumulated degree; multiply by the equatorial rate and divide by the ecliptic rate;
translations.idiomatic: subtract from the ecliptic accumulation, multiply by the equatorial rate, and divide by the ecliptic rate;

sentences.zh: 所得，以加赤道積度及所去象限，為所求赤道積度及分秒；

translations.literal: what is obtained, add to the equatorial accumulated degree and the quadrant removed—this is the sought equatorial accumulated degree and parts and seconds;
translations.idiomatic: add the result to the equatorial accumulation and the discarded quadrant to obtain the equatorial accumulation sought;

sentences.zh: 以二至赤道日度加而命之，即每日午中赤道日度及分秒。

translations.literal: Add and name from the solstice equatorial solar degree—this is each day's equatorial solar degree at noon and parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Count from the solstice equatorial position to obtain the equatorial solar degree at noon for each day.

translations.idiomatic: Entering the Xingji station; the chronogram branch is chou (Ox).

translations.idiomatic: Entering the Xuanxiao station; the chronogram branch is zi (Rat).

sentences.zh: 求入十二次時刻

translations.literal: To seek the moment of entering the twelve stations
translations.idiomatic: To compute the moment of entry into each of the twelve celestial stations

sentences.zh: 各置入次宿度及分秒，以其日晨前夜半日度減之，余以日周乘之，為實；

translations.literal: For each, set the lodge degree and parts and seconds at station entry; subtract the day's solar degree at dawn before midnight; multiply the remainder by the day circuit—this is the dividend;
translations.idiomatic: For each station, take its entry lodge position and subtract that day's dawn-before-midnight solar degree; multiply the remainder by the day divisor to form the dividend;

sentences.zh: 以其日行定度為法；

translations.literal: take the sun's fixed daily motion as the divisor;
translations.idiomatic: use the sun's true daily motion as the divisor;

sentences.zh: 實如法而一，所得，依發斂加時求之，即入次時刻。

translations.literal: divide the dividend by the divisor; what is obtained, seek by ebb-and-flow with added double-hours—this is the moment of station entry.
translations.idiomatic: divide dividend by divisor and convert the result via the ebb-and-flow added-double-hour procedure to obtain the moment of station entry.
