sentences.zh: 推天正經朔入轉

translations.literal: Procedure for the standard new moon of the celestial first month entering rotation
translations.idiomatic: To compute when the celestial first month's standard new moon enters the rotation sequence

sentences.zh: 置中積，加轉應，減閏余，滿轉終分，去之，不盡，以日周約之為日，不滿為分，即天正經朔入轉日及分。

translations.literal: Set the mean accumulation; add the rotation correspondence; subtract the intercalation remainder; when it fills the rotation end parts, remove it; what does not exhaust, reduce by the day circuit to days; what does not fill is parts—this is the standard new moon of the celestial first month entering rotation, day and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Take the mean accumulation, add the rotation epoch offset, subtract the intercalation remainder, discard full rotation-end cycles, divide the remainder by the day divisor for days and keep the leftover as parts—this yields the celestial first month's standard new moon entering rotation, in days and parts.

sentences.zh: 〈（上考者，中積內加所求閏余，減轉應，滿轉終，去之，不盡，以減轉終，餘同上。）〉

translations.literal: (For the upward examination, add the sought intercalation remainder within the mean accumulation; subtract the rotation correspondence; when it fills the rotation end, remove it; what does not exhaust, subtract from the rotation end—the remainder as above.)
translations.idiomatic: (For backward projection, add the intercalation remainder to the mean accumulation, subtract the rotation epoch offset, discard full rotation-end cycles, subtract the remainder from the rotation end, and proceed as above.)

sentences.zh: 求弦望及次朔入轉

translations.literal: To seek quarter-moon, full moon, and successive new moon entering rotation
translations.idiomatic: To compute when each quarter-moon, full moon, and successive new moon enters the rotation sequence

sentences.zh: 置天正經朔入轉日及分，以弦策累加之，滿轉終，去之，即弦望及次朔入轉日及分秒。

translations.literal: Set the standard new moon of the celestial first month entering rotation, day and parts; add the quarter-moon interval cumulatively; when it fills the rotation end, remove it—this yields quarter-moon, full moon, and successive new moon entering rotation, day and parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Start from the celestial first month's standard new moon entering rotation and add the quarter-moon interval repeatedly, discarding full rotation-end cycles, to obtain each quarter-moon, full moon, and successive new moon entering rotation with its days, parts, and seconds.

sentences.zh: 如徑求次朔，以轉差加之。

translations.literal: If directly seeking the next new moon, add the rotation difference.
translations.idiomatic: To jump directly to the next new moon, add the rotation increment.

sentences.zh: 求經朔弦望入遲疾歷

translations.literal: To seek the standard new moon, quarter-moons, and full moon entering the slow-fast sequence
translations.idiomatic: To determine each standard new moon, quarter-moon, and full moon's position in the slow-fast sequence

sentences.zh: 各視入轉日及分秒，在轉中已下，為疾歷；

translations.literal: For each, inspect the rotation entry day and parts and seconds; when at or below the rotation midpoint, it is the fast sequence;
translations.idiomatic: For each event, take its rotation entry in days, parts, and seconds; if at or below the rotation midpoint, it falls in the fast sequence;

sentences.zh: 已上，減去轉中，為遲歷。

translations.literal: when above, subtract the rotation midpoint—this is the slow sequence.
translations.idiomatic: if above the midpoint, subtract the rotation midpoint to obtain the slow-sequence position.

sentences.zh: 遲疾轉定及積度

translations.literal: Slow-fast rotation fixed values and accumulated degrees
translations.idiomatic: Fixed slow-fast rotation values and accumulated degrees

translations.literal: (Table abbreviated.)
translations.idiomatic: (Table omitted.)

sentences.zh: 求遲疾差

translations.literal: To seek the slow-fast difference
translations.idiomatic: To compute the slow-fast correction

sentences.zh: 置遲疾歷日及分，以十二限二十分乘之，在初限已下為初限，已上覆減中限，余為末限。

translations.literal: Set the slow-fast sequence day and parts; multiply by twelve-limit twenty parts; when below the initial limit, it is the initial limit; when at or above, inversely subtract the middle limit—the remainder is the final limit.
translations.idiomatic: Take the position in the slow-fast sequence and multiply by the twelve-limit scaling factor plus twenty parts; values below the initial limit stay in the initial segment; otherwise subtract from the middle limit to obtain the final segment.

sentences.zh: 置立差三百二十五，以初末限乘之，加平差二萬八千一百，又以初末限乘之，用減定差一千一百一十一萬，余再以初末限乘之，滿億為度，不滿退除為分秒，即遲疾差。

translations.literal: Set the base difference at 325; multiply by the initial-final limit; add the mean difference 28,100; multiply again by the initial-final limit; subtract from the fixed difference 11,110,000; multiply the remainder again by the initial-final limit; when it fills 100 million, count as degrees; what does not fill, step back to parts and seconds—this is the slow-fast difference.
translations.idiomatic: Set the base difference to 325, multiply by the segment limit, add the mean difference 28,100, multiply again, subtract from the fixed difference 11,110,000, multiply once more, and convert to degrees and parts and seconds—this is the slow-fast correction.

sentences.zh: 又術：置遲疾歷日及分，以遲疾歷日率減之，余以其下損益分乘之，如八百二十而一，益加損減其下遲疾度，亦為所求遲疾差。

translations.literal: Alternate method: set the slow-fast sequence day and parts; subtract the slow-fast sequence day-rate; multiply the remainder by the increase-decrease parts below; divide by 820; increase add, decrease subtract the slow-fast degree below—this also yields the sought slow-fast difference.
translations.idiomatic: Alternate method: take the slow-fast sequence position, subtract the tabulated day-rate, multiply the remainder by the increase-decrease rate below, divide by 820, and add or subtract from the tabulated slow-fast degree below—this also yields the correction sought.

sentences.zh: 求朔弦望定日

translations.literal: To seek the fixed days of new moon, quarter-moons, and full moon
translations.idiomatic: To compute the true dates of new moon, quarter-moons, and full moon

sentences.zh: 以經朔弦望盈縮差與遲疾差，同名相從，異名相消，

translations.literal: Take the standard new moon, quarter-moons, and full moon expansion-contraction difference and the slow-fast difference; same name follow together, different name cancel each other,
translations.idiomatic: Combine the expansion-contraction correction and slow-fast correction for each standard new moon, quarter-moon, and full moon—add when they share the same sign, subtract when they oppose,

sentences.zh: 〈（盈遲縮疾為同名，盈疾縮遲為異名。）〉

translations.literal: (Expansion-slow and contraction-fast are same name; expansion-fast and contraction-slow are different name.)
translations.idiomatic: (Expansion with slow and contraction with fast count as same sign; expansion with fast and contraction with slow count as opposite signs.)

sentences.zh: 以八百二十乘之，以所入遲疾限下行度除之，即為加減差，

translations.literal: multiply by 820; divide by the daily motion degree below the slow-fast limit entered—this is the add-subtract difference,
translations.idiomatic: multiply by 820 and divide by the tabulated daily motion for that slow-fast segment to obtain the add-subtract correction,

sentences.zh: 〈（盈遲為加，縮疾為減。）〉

translations.literal: (Expansion-slow is add; contraction-fast is subtract.)
translations.idiomatic: (Add for expansion-slow; subtract for contraction-fast.)

sentences.zh: 以加減經朔弦望日及分，即定朔弦望日及分。

translations.literal: add or subtract to the standard new moon, quarter-moons, and full moon day and parts—this is the fixed new moon, quarter-moons, and full moon day and parts.
translations.idiomatic: apply this correction to the standard new moon, quarter-moon, or full moon day and parts to obtain the true date and fractional parts.

sentences.zh: 若定弦望分在日出分已下者，退一日，其日命甲子算外，各得定朔弦望日辰。

translations.literal: If the fixed quarter-moon or full moon parts are below the sunrise parts, retreat one day; name the day counting from jiazi beyond—each yields the fixed new moon, quarter-moons, and full moon day and chronogram.
translations.idiomatic: If a true quarter-moon or full moon falls before sunrise on its fractional day, move back one day; count from jiazi beyond to obtain each true new moon, quarter-moon, and full moon with its day and chronogram branch.

sentences.zh: 定朔干名與後朔干同者，其月大；

translations.literal: When the fixed new moon stem name matches the next new moon stem, the month is long;
translations.idiomatic: If the true new moon's stem name matches the following new moon's stem, the month is long (30 days);

sentences.zh: 不同者，其月小；

translations.literal: when different, the month is short;
translations.idiomatic: if they differ, the month is short (29 days);

sentences.zh: 內無中氣者，為閏月。

translations.literal: when it contains no mid-qi within, it is an intercalary month.
translations.idiomatic: a month containing no mid-qi is intercalary.

sentences.zh: 推定朔弦望加時日月宿度

translations.literal: Procedure for the fixed new moon, quarter-moons, and full moon added-double-hour sun and moon lodge degrees
translations.idiomatic: To compute the sun and moon lodge positions at the epoch hour for each true new moon, quarter-moon, and full moon

sentences.zh: 置經朔弦望入盈縮歷日及分，以加減差加減之，為定朔弦望入歷，在盈，便為中積，在縮，加半歲周，為中積；

translations.literal: Set the standard new moon, quarter-moons, and full moon entry into the expansion-contraction sequence, day and parts; add or subtract the add-subtract difference—this is the fixed new moon, quarter-moons, and full moon sequence entry; when in expansion, it is directly the mean accumulation; when in contraction, add the half-year circuit as mean accumulation;
translations.idiomatic: Take each standard event's entry into the expansion-contraction sequence and adjust by the add-subtract correction to obtain its true sequence entry; if in expansion, use it directly as mean accumulation; if in contraction, add the half-year circuit;

sentences.zh: 命日為度，以盈縮差盈加縮減之，為加時定積度；

translations.literal: name the day as degrees; expansion add, contraction subtract by the expansion-contraction difference—this is the added-double-hour fixed accumulated degree;
translations.idiomatic: convert days to degrees and apply the expansion-contraction correction—adding for expansion, subtracting for contraction—to obtain the true accumulated degree at the epoch hour;

sentences.zh: 以冬至加時日躔黃道宿度加而命之，各得定朔弦望加時日度。

translations.literal: add and name from the winter solstice added-double-hour solar motion ecliptic lodge degree—each yields the fixed new moon, quarter-moons, and full moon added-double-hour solar degree.
translations.idiomatic: count forward from the winter solstice ecliptic position at the epoch hour to obtain each true new moon, quarter-moon, and full moon solar degree at the epoch hour.

sentences.zh: 凡合朔加時，日月同度，便為定朔加時月度，其弦望各以弦望度加定積，為定弦望月行定積度，依上加而命之，各得定弦望加時黃道月度。

translations.literal: For conjunction at added double-hour, sun and moon share the same degree—this is directly the fixed new moon added-double-hour lunar degree; for quarter-moons and full moon, each adds the quarter-moon or full moon degree to the fixed accumulation as the fixed quarter-moon or full moon lunar motion fixed accumulated degree; add and name as above—each yields the fixed quarter-moon or full moon added-double-hour ecliptic lunar degree.
translations.idiomatic: At conjunction the sun and moon share the same degree, giving the true new moon's lunar position at the epoch hour; for quarter-moons and full moon, add the quarter or full-moon arc to the fixed accumulation and count forward from the winter solstice position to obtain each true quarter-moon or full moon ecliptic lunar degree at the epoch hour.

sentences.zh: 推定朔弦望加時赤道月度

translations.literal: Procedure for the fixed new moon, quarter-moons, and full moon added-double-hour equatorial lunar degrees
translations.idiomatic: To compute the equatorial lunar positions at the epoch hour for each true new moon, quarter-moon, and full moon

sentences.zh: 各置定朔弦望加時黃道月行定積度，滿象限，去之，以其黃道積度減之，余以赤道率乘之，如黃道率而一，用加其下赤道積度及所去象限，各為赤道加時定積度；

translations.literal: For each, set the fixed new moon, quarter-moons, and full moon added-double-hour ecliptic lunar motion fixed accumulated degree; when it fills the quadrant limit, remove it; subtract its ecliptic accumulated degree inward; multiply the remainder by the equatorial rate and divide by the ecliptic rate; add to the equatorial accumulated degree below and the quadrant removed—each is the equatorial added-double-hour fixed accumulated degree;
translations.idiomatic: For each event, take the true ecliptic lunar accumulation at the epoch hour, discard full quadrant limits, subtract the ecliptic accumulation, multiply by the equatorial rate and divide by the ecliptic rate, then add to the tabulated equatorial accumulation and discarded quadrant to obtain the equatorial fixed accumulation at the epoch hour;

sentences.zh: 以冬至加時赤道日度加而命之，各為定朔弦望加時赤道月度及分秒。

translations.literal: add and name from the winter solstice added-double-hour equatorial solar degree—each is the fixed new moon, quarter-moons, and full moon added-double-hour equatorial lunar degree and parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: count forward from the winter solstice equatorial position at the epoch hour to obtain each true new moon, quarter-moon, and full moon equatorial lunar position in degrees, parts, and seconds.

sentences.zh: 〈（象限已下及半周，去之，為至後；

translations.literal: (When below the quadrant limit and half circuit, remove it—this is after the solstice;
translations.idiomatic: (Discard the quadrant limit and half circuit to mark the post-solstice segment;

sentences.zh: 滿象限及三象，去之，為分後。）〉

translations.literal: (when it fills the quadrant limit and three quadrants, remove it—this is after the division.)
translations.idiomatic: (discard the quadrant limit and three quadrants to mark the post-equinox segment.)

sentences.zh: 推朔後平交入轉遲疾歷

translations.literal: Procedure for post-new-moon mean node entry into rotation slow-fast sequence
translations.idiomatic: To compute the post-new-moon mean node entry into the rotation slow-fast sequence

sentences.zh: 置交終日及分，內減經朔入交日及分，為朔後平交日；

translations.literal: Set the nodical end day and parts; subtract inward the standard new moon node entry day and parts—this is the post-new-moon mean node day;
translations.idiomatic: Take the nodical period in days and parts and subtract the standard new moon's node entry to obtain the post-new-moon mean node interval;

sentences.zh: 以加經朔入轉，為朔後平交入轉；

translations.literal: add it to the standard new moon rotation entry—this is the post-new-moon mean node rotation entry;
translations.idiomatic: add this to the standard new moon's rotation entry to obtain the post-new-moon mean node rotation entry;

sentences.zh: 在轉中已下，為疾歷；

translations.literal: when at or below the rotation midpoint, it is the fast sequence;
translations.idiomatic: if at or below the rotation midpoint, it falls in the fast sequence;

sentences.zh: 已上，去之，為遲歷。

translations.literal: when above, remove it—this is the slow sequence.
translations.idiomatic: if above, subtract the midpoint to obtain the slow-sequence position.

sentences.zh: 求正交日辰

translations.literal: To seek the true node day and chronogram
translations.idiomatic: To compute the true node crossing day and chronogram branch

sentences.zh: 置經朔，加朔後平交日，以遲疾歷依前求到遲疾差，遲加疾減之，為正交日及分，其日命甲子算外，即正交日辰。

translations.literal: Set the standard new moon; add the post-new-moon mean node day; by the slow-fast sequence seek the slow-fast difference as before; slow add, fast subtract—this is the true node day and parts; name the day counting from jiazi beyond—this is the true node day and chronogram.
translations.idiomatic: Take the standard new moon, add the post-new-moon mean node interval, compute the slow-fast correction as before, add for slow and subtract for fast, and count from jiazi beyond to obtain the true node crossing day and chronogram branch.

sentences.zh: 推正交加時黃道月度

translations.literal: Procedure for the true node added-double-hour ecliptic lunar degree
translations.idiomatic: To compute the ecliptic lunar degree at the true node crossing epoch hour

sentences.zh: 置朔後平交日，以月平行度乘之，為距後度；

translations.literal: Set the post-new-moon mean node day; multiply by the moon mean motion degree—this is the post-interval degree;
translations.idiomatic: Take the post-new-moon mean node interval and multiply by the mean lunar motion to obtain the post-interval arc;

sentences.zh: 以加經朔中積，為冬至距正交定積度；

translations.literal: add it to the standard new moon mean accumulation—this is the winter solstice-to-true-node fixed accumulated degree;
translations.idiomatic: add this to the standard new moon mean accumulation to obtain the fixed accumulated degree from winter solstice to the true node;

sentences.zh: 以冬至日躔黃道宿度加而命之，為正交加時月離黃道宿度及分秒。

translations.literal: add and name from the winter solstice solar motion ecliptic lodge degree—this is the true node added-double-hour lunar departure ecliptic lodge degree and parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: count forward from the winter solstice ecliptic position to obtain the lunar departure ecliptic lodge position at the true node epoch hour in degrees, parts, and seconds.

sentences.zh: 求正交在二至後初末限

translations.literal: To seek the true node in the initial-final limit after the two solstices
translations.idiomatic: To determine the initial or final limit segment after the solstice for the true node

sentences.zh: 置冬至距正交積度及分，在半歲周已下，為冬至後；

translations.literal: Set the winter solstice-to-true-node accumulated degree and parts; when below the half-year circuit, it is after the winter solstice;
translations.idiomatic: Take the accumulated degree from winter solstice to the true node; if below the half-year circuit, the node falls after the winter solstice;

sentences.zh: 已上，去之，為夏至後。

translations.literal: when above, remove it—this is after the summer solstice.
translations.idiomatic: if above, subtract the half-year circuit to mark the post-summer-solstice segment.

sentences.zh: 其二至後，在象限已下，為初限，已上，減去半歲周，為末限。

translations.literal: After either solstice, when below the quadrant limit, it is the initial limit; when above, subtract the half-year circuit—the remainder is the final limit.
translations.idiomatic: Within each solstice half-year: below the quadrant limit counts as the initial segment; above it, subtract the half-year circuit to obtain the final segment.

sentences.zh: 求定差距差定限度

translations.literal: To seek the fixed difference, distance difference, and fixed limit degree
translations.idiomatic: To compute the fixed difference, distance difference, and fixed limit degree

sentences.zh: 置初末限度，以十四度六十六分乘之，如象限而一，為定差；

translations.literal: Set the initial-final limit degree; multiply by 14°66'; divide by the quadrant limit—this is the fixed difference;
translations.idiomatic: Take the segment limit, multiply by 14°66′, divide by the quadrant limit, and obtain the fixed difference;

sentences.zh: 反減十四度六十六分，余為距差。

translations.literal: inversely subtract from 14°66'; the remainder is the distance difference.
translations.idiomatic: subtract from 14°66′ to obtain the distance difference.

sentences.zh: 以二十四乘定差，如十四度六十六分而一；

translations.literal: Multiply the fixed difference by 24; divide by 14°66';
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the fixed difference by 24 and divide by 14°66′;

sentences.zh: 所得，交在冬至後名減，夏至後名加，皆加減九十八度，為定限度及分秒。

translations.literal: what is obtained: when the node is after the winter solstice, name subtract; after the summer solstice, name add; each add or subtract 98°—this is the fixed limit degree and parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the result: subtract for nodes after the winter solstice, add for nodes after the summer solstice, each time adjusting by 98° to obtain the fixed limit degree in degrees, parts, and seconds.

sentences.zh: 求四正赤道宿度

translations.literal: To seek the four cardinals' equatorial lodge degrees
translations.idiomatic: To compute the equatorial lodge positions of the four seasonal nodes

sentences.zh: 置冬至加時赤道度，命為冬至正度；

translations.literal: Set the winter solstice added-double-hour equatorial degree; name it as the winter solstice cardinal degree;
translations.idiomatic: Take the winter solstice equatorial position at the epoch hour and designate it as the winter solstice cardinal degree;

sentences.zh: 以象限累加之，各得春分、夏至、秋分正積度；

translations.literal: add the quadrant limit cumulatively—each yields the spring equinox, summer solstice, and autumn equinox cardinal accumulated degrees;
translations.idiomatic: add the quadrant limit repeatedly to obtain the cardinal accumulated degrees for spring equinox, summer solstice, and autumn equinox;

sentences.zh: 各命赤道宿次去之，為四正赤道宿度及分秒。

translations.literal: for each, add and name from the equatorial lodge sequence and remove—this is the four cardinals' equatorial lodge degrees and parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: for each, count through the equatorial lodge sequence and discard full cycles to obtain the four seasonal nodes' equatorial lodge positions in degrees, parts, and seconds.

sentences.zh: 求月離赤道正交宿度

translations.literal: To seek the lunar departure equatorial true node lodge degree
translations.idiomatic: To compute the equatorial lodge position of the moon's true node crossing

sentences.zh: 以距差加減春秋二正赤道宿度，為月離赤道正交宿度及分秒。

translations.literal: Add or subtract the distance difference to the spring and autumn cardinal equatorial lodge degrees—this is the lunar departure equatorial true node lodge degree and parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the distance difference to the spring and autumn equinox equatorial lodge positions to obtain the moon's true node equatorial lodge position in degrees, parts, and seconds.

sentences.zh: 冬至後，初限加，末限減，視春正；

translations.literal: After the winter solstice: initial limit add, final limit subtract—refer to the spring cardinal;
translations.idiomatic: After the winter solstice: add for the initial segment, subtract for the final segment, using the spring equinox position as reference;

sentences.zh: 夏至後，初限減，末限加，視秋正。

translations.literal: after the summer solstice: initial limit subtract, final limit add—refer to the autumn cardinal.
translations.idiomatic: after the summer solstice: subtract for the initial segment, add for the final segment, using the autumn equinox position as reference.

sentences.zh: 求正交後赤道積度入初末限

translations.literal: To seek the post-true-node equatorial accumulated degree entering the initial-final limit
translations.idiomatic: To determine the initial or final limit segment for the equatorial accumulation after the true node

sentences.zh: 各置春秋二正赤道所當宿全度及分，以月離赤道正交宿度及分減之，余為正交後積度；

translations.literal: For each, set the full degree and parts of the spring and autumn cardinal equatorial lodges occupied; subtract the lunar departure equatorial true node lodge degree and parts—the remainder is the post-true-node accumulated degree;
translations.idiomatic: For each equinox, take the full span of the occupied equatorial lodge and subtract the moon's true node equatorial position; the remainder is the accumulated degree after the true node;

sentences.zh: 以赤道宿次累加之，滿象限去之，為半交後；

translations.literal: add equatorial lodge spans cumulatively; when it fills the quadrant limit, remove it—this is after the half node;
translations.idiomatic: add equatorial lodge spans cumulatively, discarding full quadrant limits, to mark the post-half-node segment;

sentences.zh: 又去之，為中交後；

translations.literal: remove it again—this is after the middle node;
translations.idiomatic: discard another quadrant limit to mark the post-middle-node segment;

sentences.zh: 再去之，為半交後；

translations.literal: remove it again—this is after the half node;
translations.idiomatic: discard another quadrant limit to mark the post-half-node segment;

sentences.zh: 視各交積度在半象已下，為初限；

translations.literal: inspect each node's accumulated degree—when below the half quadrant, it is the initial limit;
translations.idiomatic: for each node segment, if the accumulated degree falls below half a quadrant, count it as the initial limit;

sentences.zh: 已上，用減象限，余為末限。

translations.literal: when above, subtract the quadrant limit inward—the remainder is the final limit.
translations.idiomatic: if above, subtract the quadrant limit to obtain the final limit segment.

sentences.zh: 求月離赤道正交後半交白道舊名九道出入赤道內外度及定差

translations.literal: To seek the lunar departure equatorial post-true-node, post-half-node white path—formerly named the nine paths—entry-exit equator inner-outer degree and fixed difference
translations.idiomatic: To compute the white-path latitude—entry and exit relative to the equator, formerly called the nine paths—after the equatorial true and half nodes, and the fixed difference

sentences.zh: 置各交定差度及分，以二十五乘之，如六十一而一；

translations.literal: Set each node's fixed difference degree and parts; multiply by 25; divide by 61;
translations.idiomatic: Take each node's fixed difference in degrees and parts, multiply by 25, and divide by 61;

sentences.zh: 所得，視月離黃道正交在冬至後宿度為減，夏至後宿度為加，皆加減二十三度九十分，為月離赤道後半交白道出入赤道內外度及分；

translations.literal: what is obtained: inspect the lunar departure ecliptic true node—when in post-winter-solstice lodge degree, name subtract; post-summer-solstice lodge degree, name add; each add or subtract 23°90'—this is the lunar departure equatorial post-half-node white path entry-exit equator inner-outer degree and parts;
translations.idiomatic: Apply the result: subtract when the ecliptic true node falls after the winter solstice, add when it falls after the summer solstice, each time adjusting by 23°90′, to obtain the white-path entry and exit relative to the equator after the equatorial half node, in degrees and parts;

sentences.zh: 以周天六之一，六十度八十七分六十二秒半，除之，為定差。）

translations.literal: divide by one-sixth of the circuit heaven, 60°87'62.5″—this is the fixed difference.)
translations.idiomatic: divide by one-sixth of the circuit of heaven, 60°87′62.5″, to obtain the fixed difference.)

sentences.zh: 月離赤道正交後為外，中交後為內。

translations.literal: After the lunar departure equatorial true node is outer; after the middle node is inner.
translations.idiomatic: After the equatorial true node the moon is north of the equator; after the middle node it is south.

sentences.zh: 求月離出入赤道內外白道去極度

translations.literal: To seek the lunar departure entry-exit equator inner-outer white path polar distance
translations.idiomatic: To compute the white-path polar distance as the moon crosses north or south of the equator

sentences.zh: 置每日月離赤道交後初末限，用減象限，余為白道積；

translations.literal: Set each day's lunar departure equatorial post-node initial-final limit; subtract the quadrant limit inward—the remainder is the white path accumulation;
translations.idiomatic: For each day, take the initial or final limit after the equatorial node and subtract the quadrant limit to obtain the white-path accumulation;

sentences.zh: 用其積度減之，余以其差率乘之；

translations.literal: subtract its accumulated degree inward; multiply the remainder by its difference rate;
translations.idiomatic: subtract the tabulated accumulated degree and multiply the remainder by the difference rate;

sentences.zh: 所得，百約之，以加其下積差，為每日積差；

translations.literal: what is obtained, reduce by hundred; add to its lower accumulated difference—this is each day's accumulated difference;
translations.idiomatic: divide the result by 100, add it to the next lower tabulated accumulated difference, and obtain each day's accumulated difference;

sentences.zh: 用減周天六之一，余以定差乘之，為每日月離赤道內外度；

translations.literal: subtract one-sixth of the circuit heaven inward; multiply the remainder by the fixed difference—this is each day's lunar departure equatorial inner-outer degree;
translations.idiomatic: subtract one-sixth of the circuit of heaven and multiply the remainder by the fixed difference to obtain each day's equatorial latitude;

sentences.zh: 內減外加象限，為每日月離白道去極度及分秒。

translations.literal: inner subtract, outer add the quadrant limit—this is each day's lunar departure white path polar distance and parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: subtract the quadrant limit when inner, add it when outer, to obtain each day's white-path polar distance in degrees, parts, and seconds.

sentences.zh: 求每交月離白道積度及宿次

translations.literal: To seek each node's lunar departure white path accumulated degree and lodge position
translations.idiomatic: To compute the white-path accumulated degree and lodge position for each node crossing

sentences.zh: 置定限度，與初末限相減相乘，退位為分，為定差；

translations.literal: Set the fixed limit degree; with the initial-final limit subtract and multiply; shift place as parts—this is the fixed difference;
translations.idiomatic: Take the fixed limit degree, multiply it by the difference between the initial and final limits, shift the decimal place to obtain parts, and derive the fixed difference;

sentences.zh: 〈（正交、中交後為加，半交後為減。）〉

translations.literal: (After the true node and middle node, name add; after the half node, name subtract.)
translations.idiomatic: (Add after the true and middle nodes; subtract after the half node.)

sentences.zh: 以差加減正交後赤道積度，為月離白道定積度；

translations.literal: add or subtract the difference to the post-true-node equatorial accumulated degree—this is the lunar departure white path fixed accumulated degree;
translations.idiomatic: apply the correction to the equatorial accumulation after the true node to obtain the fixed white-path accumulated degree;

sentences.zh: 以前宿白道定積度減之，各得月離白道宿次及分。

translations.literal: subtract by the previous lodge's white path fixed accumulated degree—each yields the lunar departure white path lodge position and parts.
translations.idiomatic: subtract each preceding lodge's fixed white-path accumulation to obtain the moon's white-path lodge position and fractional parts.

sentences.zh: 推定朔弦望加時月離白道宿度

translations.literal: Procedure for the fixed new moon, quarter-moons, and full moon added-double-hour lunar departure white path lodge degree
translations.idiomatic: To compute the white-path lodge degree at the epoch hour for each true new moon, quarter-moon, and full moon

sentences.zh: 各以月離赤道正交宿度距所求定朔弦望加時月離赤道宿度，為正交後積度；

translations.literal: For each, the lunar departure equatorial true node lodge degree distance to the sought fixed new moon, quarter-moons, and full moon added-double-hour lunar departure equatorial lodge degree—this is the post-true-node accumulated degree;
translations.idiomatic: For each event, measure from the equatorial true-node position to the sought equatorial lunar position at the epoch hour; the result is the accumulated degree after the true node;

sentences.zh: 滿象限，去之，為半交後；

translations.literal: when it fills the quadrant limit, remove it—this is after the half node;
translations.idiomatic: discard a full quadrant limit to mark the post-half-node segment;

sentences.zh: 又去之，為中交後；

translations.literal: remove it again—this is after the middle node;
translations.idiomatic: discard another quadrant limit to mark the post-middle-node segment;

sentences.zh: 再去之，為半交後；

translations.literal: remove it again—this is after the half node;
translations.idiomatic: discard another quadrant limit to mark the post-half-node segment;

sentences.zh: 視交後積度在半象已下，為初限；

translations.literal: inspect the post-node accumulated degree—when below the half quadrant, it is the initial limit;
translations.idiomatic: if the post-node accumulation falls below half a quadrant, count it as the initial limit;

sentences.zh: 已上，用減象限，為末限；

translations.literal: when above, subtract the quadrant limit inward—this is the final limit;
translations.idiomatic: if above, subtract the quadrant limit to obtain the final limit segment;

sentences.zh: 以初末限與定限度相減相乘，退位為分，分滿百為度，為定差；）

translations.literal: the initial-final limit with the fixed limit degree subtract and multiply; shift place as parts; parts fill hundred as degree—this is the fixed difference;）
translations.idiomatic: multiply the fixed limit degree by the difference between the initial and final limits, shift the decimal place to parts, convert parts to degrees when they reach 100, and obtain the fixed difference;）

sentences.zh: 正交中交後為加，半交後為減。

translations.literal: (After the true node and middle node, name add; after the half node, name subtract.)
translations.idiomatic: (Add after the true and middle nodes; subtract after the half node.)

sentences.zh: 以差加減月離赤道正交後積度，為定積度，以正交宿度加之，以其所當月離白道宿次去之，各得定朔弦望加時月離白道宿度及分秒。

translations.literal: add or subtract the difference to the lunar departure equatorial post-true-node accumulated degree—this is the fixed accumulated degree; add the true node lodge degree; subtract by its corresponding lunar departure white path lodge position—each yields the fixed new moon, quarter-moons, and full moon added-double-hour lunar departure white path lodge degree and parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the correction to the equatorial accumulation after the true node to obtain the fixed accumulation, add the true-node position, subtract the corresponding white-path lodge span, and obtain each true new moon, quarter-moon, and full moon white-path position at the epoch hour in degrees, parts, and seconds.

sentences.zh: 求定朔弦望加時及夜半晨昏入轉

translations.literal: To seek the fixed new moon, quarter-moons, and full moon added-double-hour and midnight, dawn, and dusk rotation entry
translations.idiomatic: To compute rotation entry at the epoch hour, midnight, dawn, and dusk for each true new moon, quarter-moon, and full moon

sentences.zh: 置經朔弦望入轉日及分，以定朔弦望加減差加減之，為定朔弦望加時入轉；

translations.literal: Set the standard new moon, quarter-moons, and full moon rotation entry day and parts; add or subtract by the fixed new moon, quarter-moons, and full moon add-subtract difference—this is the fixed new moon, quarter-moons, and full moon added-double-hour rotation entry;
translations.idiomatic: Take each standard event's rotation entry in days and parts and adjust by the true new-moon, quarter-moon, and full-moon correction to obtain rotation entry at the epoch hour;

sentences.zh: 以定朔弦望日下分減之，為夜半入轉；

translations.literal: subtract the fixed new moon, quarter-moons, and full moon day remainder parts—this is the midnight rotation entry;
translations.idiomatic: subtract the fractional day at the true event to obtain midnight rotation entry;

sentences.zh: 以晨分加之，為晨轉；

translations.literal: add the dawn parts—this is the dawn rotation;
translations.idiomatic: add the dawn fraction to obtain dawn rotation entry;

sentences.zh: 昏分加之，為昏轉。

translations.literal: add the dusk parts—this is the dusk rotation.
translations.idiomatic: add the dusk fraction to obtain dusk rotation entry.

sentences.zh: 求夜半月度

translations.literal: To seek the midnight lunar degree
translations.idiomatic: To compute the lunar position at midnight

sentences.zh: 置定朔弦望日下分，以其入轉日轉定度乘之，萬約為加時轉度，以減加時定積度，余為夜半定積度；

translations.literal: Set the fixed new moon, quarter-moons, and full moon day remainder parts; multiply by its rotation entry day rotation fixed degree; reduce by ten thousand as the added-double-hour rotation degree; subtract from the added-double-hour fixed accumulated degree—the remainder is the midnight fixed accumulated degree;
translations.idiomatic: Take the fractional day at each true event, multiply by the tabulated daily rotation degree, divide by 10,000 to obtain the rotation arc at the epoch hour, subtract it from the fixed accumulation at the epoch hour, and obtain the fixed accumulation at midnight;

sentences.zh: 依前加而命之，各得夜半月離宿度及分秒。

translations.literal: add and name as before—each yields the midnight lunar departure lodge degree and parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: count forward as before to obtain each midnight lunar position in degrees, parts, and seconds.

sentences.zh: 求晨昏月度

translations.literal: To seek the dawn-dusk lunar degree
translations.idiomatic: To compute the lunar position at dawn and dusk

sentences.zh: 置其日晨昏分，以夜半入轉日轉定度乘之，萬約為晨昏轉度；

translations.literal: Set that day's dawn-dusk parts; multiply by the midnight rotation entry day rotation fixed degree; reduce by ten thousand as the dawn-dusk rotation degree;
translations.idiomatic: Take that day's dawn or dusk fraction, multiply by the tabulated daily rotation degree from midnight entry, and divide by 10,000 to obtain the dawn-dusk rotation arc;

sentences.zh: 各加夜半定積度，為晨昏定積度；

translations.literal: each add the midnight fixed accumulated degree—this is the dawn-dusk fixed accumulated degree;
translations.idiomatic: add each to the midnight fixed accumulation to obtain the fixed accumulation at dawn or dusk;

sentences.zh: 加命如前，各得晨昏月離宿度及分秒。

translations.literal: add and name as before—each yields the dawn-dusk lunar departure lodge degree and parts and seconds.
translations.idiomatic: count forward as before to obtain each dawn and dusk lunar position in degrees, parts, and seconds.

sentences.zh: 求每日晨昏月離白道宿次

translations.literal: To seek each day's dawn-dusk lunar departure white path lodge position
translations.idiomatic: To compute the daily dawn and dusk white-path lodge positions

sentences.zh: 累計相距日數轉定度，為轉積度；

translations.literal: cumulatively count the separated day count rotation fixed degree—this is the rotation accumulated degree;
translations.idiomatic: sum the daily rotation degrees over the intervening days to obtain the accumulated rotation arc;

sentences.zh: 與定朔弦望晨昏宿次前後相距度相減，余以相距日數除之，為日差；

translations.literal: subtract from the fixed new moon, quarter-moons, and full moon dawn-dusk lodge position before-after separated degree; divide the remainder by the separated day count—this is the day difference;
translations.idiomatic: subtract the dawn-dusk lodge positions before and after each true event and divide the difference by the number of intervening days to obtain the daily correction;

sentences.zh: 〈（距度多為加，距度少為減。）〉

translations.literal: (When the separation degree is more, name add; when less, name subtract.)
translations.idiomatic: (Add when the separation arc is larger; subtract when it is smaller.)

sentences.zh: 以加減每日轉定度，為行定度；

translations.literal: add or subtract to each day's rotation fixed degree—this is the motion fixed degree;
translations.idiomatic: apply the correction to each day's tabulated rotation degree to obtain the true daily motion;

sentences.zh: 以累加定朔弦望晨昏月度，加命如前，即每日晨昏月離白道宿次。

translations.literal: cumulatively add the fixed new moon, quarter-moons, and full moon dawn-dusk lunar degree; add and name as before—thus each day's dawn-dusk lunar departure white path lodge position.
translations.idiomatic: accumulate from each true event's dawn-dusk lunar position, count forward as before, and obtain the daily dawn and dusk white-path lodge positions.

sentences.zh: 〈（朔後用晨，望後用昏，朔望晨昏俱用。）〉

translations.literal: (After the new moon use dawn; after the full moon use dusk; at new moon and full moon use both dawn and dusk.)
translations.idiomatic: (After new moon use the dawn position; after full moon use the dusk position; at new moon and full moon use both dawn and dusk.)
